project.name: RAG Chatbot
project.description: A simple chatbot that retrieves relevant information from local documents before answering questions.
project.supported_files: The ingestion pipeline supports JSON, TXT, Markdown, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PNG, JPG, and TIFF files.

usage.ingest: Run python ingestion_pipeline.py --reset to build the local vector store.
usage.start: Run python app.py and open http://127.0.0.1:8000 in a browser.
usage.openai: Set OPENAI_API_KEY in the .env file for generated answers. Without it, the app runs in retrieval-only mode.
